## Purpose
The persisted history of workflow-planner runs in this browser, so a past plan reopens through the same layer timeline that watched it.

## Responsibilities
- **`PlannerRun`:**
  - id, runId, goal, workflowName;
  - status: completed, failed or cancelled;
  - createdAt, detail;
  - manifest (`LayerManifestEntry[]`), runtime (layer name → `LayerRuntime`) and steps (`PlannerStep[]`).
- **`usePlannerHistory`:**
  - `addRun(run)` prepends with an id of `<base36 time>-<4 random>`, keeping at most 40;
  - `clear()`.
- **Persisted** under the localStorage key `agent_planner_history`.

## Key elements
`usePlannerHistory`, `PlannerRun`.

## Control flow
None.

## Data, state and side effects
localStorage.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- **Uses the types of:** `components/pipeline/PipelineTimeline` and `components/workflows/PlannerCards`.
- **Used by:** the new-workflow (AI) planner pages.

## Error handling and edge cases
None.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **`runId` prevents saving the same background run twice.**
- **Entries recorded before the layer timeline existed** have no manifest.
- **The history is per browser,** not per user or workspace.

## How to rebuild this file
A zustand store with `persist` as described.

None.
